title: User Authentication Success
description: Verify user can log in successfully with valid credentials and be redirected to the Mission Control dashboard

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Enter valid username/email and password
Click the login button
Verify the user is authenticated and redirected to the Mission Control dashboard
Verify the dashboard loads KPI cards, shipment pipeline, and live activity feed

title: User Authentication Failure
description: Verify login fails with invalid credentials and an appropriate error message is displayed

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Enter invalid username/email or password
Click the login button
Verify login is denied with error message displayed
Verify user remains on the login page

title: Role-Based Access Control Verification
description: Verify that users with different roles have access only to permitted areas and data within their tenant

steps.description: Login as a user with restricted permissions
Verify restricted pages are inaccessible and user is redirected appropriately
Attempt to access protected endpoints directly via URL
Verify unauthorized access is blocked and session remains secure

title: Mission Control Dashboard Rendering
description: Verify that the Mission Control dashboard renders all core components with live real-time data

steps.description: Login and navigate to the Mission Control dashboard
Check KPI cards display current operational metrics accurately
Validate shipment pipeline updates dynamically reflecting real-time shipment statuses
Confirm interactive Recharts load correctly with proper axis and data points
Verify live activity feed updates as new events occur

title: Create Shipment via Multi-Step Wizard
description: Test full lifecycle of shipment creation through multi-step wizard including pricing automation and barcode scanning

steps.description: Navigate to the shipment creation wizard
Complete each wizard step with valid shipment details
Use barcode scanning (camera or USB) to add shipment data
Verify pricing and automated calculations are applied correctly
Submit the shipment creation request
Verify shipment is saved and visible in the shipments list
Check that database contains correct shipment data with status 'Created'

title: Edit and Update Shipment Details
description: Verify shipment details can be updated correctly including status changes and barcode rescanning

steps.description: Locate an existing shipment in the shipments table
Open shipment drawer for editing
Modify shipment attributes such as destination, weight, or status
Re-scan barcode to update shipment if needed
Save the changes
Verify updated shipment details are persisted and visible in UI

title: Delete Shipment and Confirm Removal
description: Test deletion of shipments individually and in bulk with confirmation dialogs

steps.description: Select one or multiple shipments from the shipments table
Initiate delete action and confirm in dialog prompt
Verify shipments are removed from the list and database
Validate that deleted shipments cannot be accessed or tracked

title: Real-Time Shipment Tracking Updates
description: Validate tracking system updates shipment status and timeline visuals with max 30 seconds latency

steps.description: Navigate to tracking page
Search for shipment by AWB number
Verify shipment timeline visual updates with recent tracking events
Confirm map integration displays current shipment location correctly
Simulate shipment status changes via backend
Verify UI reflects changes in under 30 seconds

title: Manifest Creation with AI Route Optimization
description: Verify manifest creation flow supports manual and AI-optimized route assignments and driver tracking

steps.description: Navigate to manifest creation page
Create new manifest manually by selecting shipments
Validate manifest displays correct shipments
Activate AI-powered route optimization
Verify optimized route is suggested with cost/time minimization
Assign drivers to manifest and confirm assignments
Validate manifest live map tracking updates driver location
Close manifest and verify automatic closure workflow completes

title: Invoice Generation and GST Compliance
description: Test invoice generation for shipments with GST calculation, multi-channel delivery, and payment link integration

steps.description: Generate invoice for completed shipments
Verify invoice includes GST fields correctly calculated
Send invoice via email and WhatsApp Business API
Confirm invoice receipt in both channels
Click payment link from invoice and complete payment
Verify payment status updates in payment dashboard

title: Analytics Dashboard Data Accuracy and Export
description: Validate analytics dashboard charts render correctly for operational, financial and customer metrics and support data export

steps.description: Navigate to analytics dashboard
Verify area, bar, pie, and radar charts display correct data
Apply date range and filter changes
Confirm charts update dynamically with filters
Export chart data as CSV or Excel
Verify exported files contain accurate data matching displayed charts

title: Exception Handling Workflow
description: Test creation, categorization, auto-escalation and resolution assignment for shipment exceptions with user notifications

steps.description: Identify delayed or failed shipment and create exception record
Assign category and severity
Auto-escalate exception based on configured thresholds
Assign resolution tasks to users
Verify exception notifications are sent to relevant users and customers
Update exception status and add notes
Confirm changes are logged and displayed correctly

title: Route Management Vehicle Tracking and Status
description: Verify real-time vehicle location updates on map and route status indicators are accurate and interactive

steps.description: Access route management page
Confirm vehicle locations update live on interactive map
Filter routes by status and validate filtering results
Update status of a route or vehicle and observe UI change
Verify status flags and colors correspond to the updated status

title: Barcode Scanning Functionality and Offline Mode
description: Test both USB and camera barcode scanning integration with offline queuing and de-duplication

steps.description: Scan barcode using USB device
Verify scanned code is recognized and shipment details are loaded
Scan barcode using camera-based scanning
Confirm barcode data accuracy above 98%
Disconnect network and perform barcode scans offline
Verify scans are queued and synchronized when online
Scan duplicate barcode
Verify de-duplication prevents duplicate entries

title: Global Command Palette Quick Navigation
description: Verify command palette allows quick access to navigation and action commands with keyboard shortcuts

steps.description: Trigger global command palette via shortcut
Verify command palette opens overlay interface
Input command to navigate to shipments page
Confirm user navigates to shipments dashboard page instantly
Input action command, e.g., 'Create Shipment'
Verify action initiates multi-step shipment creation wizard

title: Real-Time Notification System
description: Test that critical events trigger in-app toast notifications and notification bell updates correctly

steps.description: Perform an action that triggers a notification, e.g., shipment delayed
Verify toast notification appears with correct message
Confirm notification bell icon displays updated badge counts
Click notification bell and verify notification list shows recent alerts

title: UI Component Accessibility and Theming Compliance
description: Validate all UI components adhere to semantic OKLCH-based design tokens and meet WCAG AA accessibility standards

steps.description: Render UI components with various theme settings
Verify color tokens match semantic OKLCH specifications with no hardcoded colors
Use accessibility tools to check components meet WCAG AA requirements (contrast, keyboard navigation, ARIA attributes)
Resize viewport to test responsive design behavior
Confirm UI components adapt appropriately without clipping or layout breaks

title: Performance and Load Time Validation
description: Ensure all main dashboard pages load under 2 seconds with smooth UI animations on target browsers

steps.description: Load Mission Control, Shipments, Tracking, Manifest, and Analytics pages on supported browsers
Measure initial page load times are below 2 seconds
Interact with UI animations and transitions
Verify animations run smoothly without jitter or stutter
Monitor resource usage for memory leaks or excessive CPU during user interactions

title: Session Expiration and Secure Redirects
description: Validate session expiration enforces logout and redirects to login page for unauthorized access attempts

steps.description: Login and remain idle until session expires
Verify user is logged out and redirected to login page on next interaction
Attempt to access a protected route after logout
Confirm unauthorized access is blocked and redirect to login occurs

title: Bulk Actions with Shipments Data Table
description: Verify bulk selection and operations (edit, delete) work correctly on shipments data table with proper UI feedback

steps.description: Navigate to shipments data table
Select multiple shipments using checkbox bulk select
Perform bulk edit and modify shipment status for all selected
Verify all selected shipments are updated with new status
Perform bulk delete with confirmation
Verify all selected shipments removed from list and backend

title: Exception Auto-Escalation Logic Verification
description: Check that shipment exceptions auto-escalate after configured time thresholds and notify target users

steps.description: Create an exception with low severity category
Simulate passage of escalation threshold time
Verify exception status changes to escalated
Confirm escalation notification is sent to assigned personnel

title: Invoice Payment Reconciliation Dashboard Accuracy
description: Validate payments dashboard correctly tracks payment status, reconciles invoices, and displays revenue summary charts

steps.description: Navigate to payments dashboard
Verify real-time payment statuses match backend data
Check that invoice reconciliation statuses are accurate
Confirm revenue summary charts update based on payments and reflect correct figures

title: Continuous Integration Checks
description: Ensure linting, stylelint, and security scans run successfully and block unsafe commits

steps.description: Submit code changes with hardcoded color tokens and unsafe patterns
Verify CI pipeline fails with detailed lint and security errors
Fix code issues and resubmit
Confirm CI pipeline passes all checks
